business_problem: After replacing manually developed spreadsheets with fully automated dashboards, Hershey now automatically receives complete, accurate data feeds from their largest retail customer. Hershey reached $10 billion in revenue in 2022 for the first time ever, but that hasn’t stopped the snacking powerhouse from thinking about growth.
solution_summary: The Hershey Company made chocolate accessible to everyone. Today, the company continues to find new ways to delight consumers. To gather and analyze more of the data they need to stay in front of changing human behavior, Hershey recently planned to build a data store to broaden access to data for all stakeholders across the company. Hershey chose Databricks Data + AI Platform as the foundation of their data store and implemented it with the assistance of Advancing Analytics. After replacing manually developed spreadsheets with fully automated dashboards, Hershey now automatically receives complete, accurate data feeds from their largest retail customer. Across Hershey, business leaders are embracing analytics and partnering with the data team to uncover insights that will help Hershey extend their industry leadership.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Databricks SQL
solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, self-service queries, and business intelligence for downstream users.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores curated lakehouse tables used for reliable downstream analytics and AI workloads.

data_flow: Operational, customer, and transactional data lands in Databricks, is transformed in Delta Lake tables, and is served to downstream users and applications through Databricks SQL.
business_outcome: Reported outcomes include 2,000+ Empowered business and IT users across multiple departments.
